newsitem.title: DUBAI: Qatar's QGPC revises offshore field maintenance.
newsitem.headline: Qatar's QGPC revises offshore field maintenance.

text.p: Qatar General Petroleum Corp (QGPC) said on Thursday it had revised the maintenance program for its 85,000 barrels per day (bpd) capacity offshore Bul Hanine field.

"There will now be no maintenance shutdown for the oil station (at Bul Hanine). The gas station shutdown will commence in the first week of December and will continue for up to three weeks," a statement from QGPC's Operations Directorate said.
The oil station was initially to be closed from November 12 to December 2 to allow work to improve top sides and for general maintenance inspection, but high winds delayed work.
OPEC member Qatar produces some 500,000 bpd.
